description:
The Duskbloods The STORY So FAR - Is it RELATED to Bloodborne???
In this Fextralife video, we're going to be taking a look at the Duskbloods and what we know so far about the lore of the game. We'll attempt to surmise what we can from the pieces we do have, and then offer a few theories about where we think the overall story is headed, based on some clear inspirations for the title.
